activity_statements.statement: designs and manufactures passenger vehicles, trucks, and SUVs including the F-150 (America's best-selling truck), Mustang, Explorer, and Bronco for retail and fleet customers
produces and sells battery electric vehicles (BEVs) including the F-150 Lightning and Mustang Mach-E through the Ford Model e segment
sells commercial and fleet vehicles (Transit vans, F-Series Super Duty trucks) to business customers through the Ford Pro segment
provides vehicle financing and leasing to consumers and dealers through Ford Credit
offers BlueCruise hands-free driver-assist technology and connected vehicle software services via subscription to vehicle owners
distributes vehicles through a network of independently owned Ford and Lincoln dealerships across the US and globally

name_reality_gap: Ford is labeled 'Motor Vehicle Manufacturing' which is accurate at a broad level; the less obvious reality is that Ford is aggressively building a software business (BlueCruise, connected services), that Ford Pro (commercial fleet) is now the company's most profitable segment, and that Ford Credit generates substantial revenue as a financial services entity.
extraction_notes: Ford corporate about page had marketing-heavy content but confirmed key product lines. Ford investor relations page timed out. Segment structure (Ford Blue, Model e, Ford Pro, Ford Credit) is from widely reported public sources; the corporate page confirmed the three-segment operating structure in general terms.
